post.photo: A football by the back door, with a small pair of boots beside it if they are there. No people, no faces, no child. 1080 x 1350. Take it Sunday evening or Monday before 09:30.
post.instagram:
A football by the back door, and a small boy who would rather be out there with it than anywhere else.

That is our youngest. He is mad about football, and he is growing up into something his sisters never had at his age. AI has opened a whole new road, and it turned up while we were still working out the last one.

For years we thought the job was to hold things back until a child was old enough. But old enough for what keeps changing. First it was the tablet. Then it was social media. Now it is a machine that answers back.

We do not know what that road will look like by the time he is sixteen. Nobody does.

What we do know is that we cannot keep him off it until his sixteenth birthday and then wish him luck.

What is the newest thing your child uses that did not exist when you were their age?
